subsections.h3: Geometry Get Ready — Week by Week

weeks.title: Week 1 — Proof-based thinking:
weeks.body: Geometry is the first course most students encounter that requires formal logical reasoning. Week 1 introduces the language and structure of geometric proof — definitions, postulates, and theorems — and how to use them to justify conclusions. Students work through triangle congruence and basic angle relationships, learning to write two-column proofs with the instructor modeling each step before students attempt independently.

weeks.title: Week 2 — Similarity, circles, and coordinate geometry:
weeks.body: Week 2 expands into similarity, the Pythagorean theorem in coordinate contexts, and basic circle properties. These are the topics that appear most frequently in the first month of a DUSD Geometry course. By the end of Week 2, students understand the logical structure of Geometry and have practiced the core proof types they will encounter on their first assessments.

whoTeaches.heading: Who teaches this program
whoTeaches.body: Geometry Get Ready is led by a math instructor trained specifically in DUSD's Geometry curriculum. The instructor understands the shift from algebraic to geometric thinking that trips up even strong Algebra students — and structures the sprint to close that gap before school starts. With a maximum of 8 students, every session includes direct feedback on each student's proof writing, not just whole-group instruction.

whyGrowWise.heading: Why GrowWise for Geometry
whyGrowWise.body: Geometry is consistently one of the courses Tri-Valley parents ask us about most — because it is the first time many strong math students struggle. The shift to proof-based reasoning is genuinely different from everything they have done before in math. GrowWise Geometry Get Ready was built specifically to ease that transition — with a DUSD-aligned curriculum, a subject-trained instructor, and a small-group format that gives every student real feedback on their proof writing before the grade counts.

faq.question: How much does Geometry Get Ready cost in Dublin, CA?
faq.answer: Geometry Get Ready starts at $279 for a 2-week cohort (6 sessions). Enrolling in both June cohorts is $499 upfront — a $59 savings vs enrolling separately. Pricing is shown on the academic summer programs hub when you select Geometry Get Ready.

faq.question: Is there a thank-you benefit for Summer Get Ready families?
faq.answer: Yes. Families who enroll in Geometry Get Ready (or any Summer Get Ready program) and continue into a 6-month regular tutoring plan may be eligible for up to $120 total savings. Contact us to confirm eligibility for your plan.

faq.question: What Geometry topics does this program cover?
faq.answer: Geometry Get Ready covers proof-based reasoning, triangle congruence and similarity, coordinate geometry, circles, and spatial thinking — all aligned to the DUSD Geometry curriculum sequence.

faq.question: Is this a credit-bearing course?
faq.answer: No. Geometry Get Ready is a focused prep sprint — not a credit-bearing course. It prepares students to start Geometry with confidence, not to replace the course itself. For credit-bearing options, contact Dublin Unified School District directly.

faq.question: My child finished Algebra 1. Are they ready for this program?
faq.answer: Yes. Geometry Get Ready is designed for students who have completed Algebra 1 and are starting Geometry in the fall. If your child needs Algebra 1 support first, see our Algebra 1 Get Ready program at /camps/summer-algebra-dublin-ca.

faq.question: My child is strong in math — will this be too easy?
faq.answer: Geometry Get Ready is designed to be substantive, not remedial. Proof-based reasoning is genuinely challenging for most students regardless of how strong they are in algebra. Even high-performing math students benefit from an introduction to geometric proof before they encounter it in a graded class environment. The small group format (max 8 students) means the instructor can calibrate to the group's level and push further when the group is ready.

faq.question: Does this program also cover Pre-Calculus?
faq.answer: Geometry Get Ready focuses specifically on Geometry content — proofs, triangle congruence and similarity, coordinate geometry, and circles. GrowWise also offers Advanced Math (Algebra II + Precalculus) as a separate weekly summer camp program. See the Advanced Math camp on our summer programs page for details.
